### 📓 Docs Drift Check
Nothing in this diff resolved to a documentable surface (no symbol, route or SDK anchor derived from **2** changed package(s)), so **this run has no opinion** about the docs.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **168** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 3739d8d6c64f47f9f8e9e873a480cafe09b11bed` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 权限集表单里「名称」的提示改了：以前说名称总是由显示名称生成，现在说清楚两种情况，显示名称里有拉丁字母或数字就自动填，全是中文或日文就请自己输入。中文、日文、西班牙文翻译同步。
- **为什么改：** 用中文或日文起名时名称不会自动生成，用户看到的是空着的必填框，下面的提示却说已经生成了。
- **风险与回滚：** 只改提示文案，没有改任何结构、取值或创建行为。回滚即 revert。
- **先看：** `packages/spec/src/security/permission.form.ts`（`name` 行的 `helpText`）。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/security/permission-form-label-first.test.ts`，预期全绿。
- **需要你做的：** 无。不属于受管面，纯文案，由席位落地。名称框旁的即时提示是界面改动，另开为 #28232。
- **席位意见：** ACCEPT，可落地。

## 席位核对 · ACCEPT · `domain:spec` seat 2 (#18549) · 2026-10-30T18:26Z

Head `58bba46c201d9e21c04e25ddbdf602f59288629a`. Card #28180, claim 6528680976; scope per triage audit 6527260428.

- **Shape:** draft to `main`, made by the relay; `Fixes #28180`; `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` (help copy only). Changeset `@objectstack/spec` patch + `@objectstack/platform-objects` patch.
- **Contract review:** none owed. The diff changes one `helpText` string, its pin test and the four generated / hand bundles; no schema, accept set or default moves.
- **Diff read by the seat:** the new help ("Filled in from the label's Latin letters and digits when you create the set; if the label has none, type it yourself. snake_case") matches `slugify`'s `[a-z0-9]` derivation; the zh-CN / ja-JP / es-ES values say the same and name the CJK case; the test keeps a control that the unconditional promise is gone. The card thread measured that no other `*.form.ts` makes the same promise.
- **Follow-ups filed:** #28232 (the Console prompt next to Name when the derivation comes back empty, the triage-split p3 `ui/` half).
- **Gates:** check-runs on this head 39 success, 10 skipped, 0 red. `mergeable_state` clean. `check-governed-merges --branch`: NOT governed, 7 paths, +29/−8.
- **Authority:** maintainer standing go-ahead 「按 pm-dispatch 审过的pr你可以自主落地」 (2026-10-30T14:20Z, project thread).
- **Landing:** `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable` in this act.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `58bba46c201d9e21c04e25ddbdf602f59288629a`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/security/permission.form.ts + packages/spec/src/security/permission-form-label-first.test.ts, packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/{en,zh-CN,ja-JP,es-ES}.metadata-forms.generated.ts, .changeset/28180-permission-name-help-cjk.md; read for the claim: ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/createDerive.ts (slugify, empty-derivation clear), ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/anchors.ts (permission wiring)

Inputs: card #28180 (body + triage 6527260428 + claim 6528680976 + os-dev-report 6529942225), PR body, the 7-file diff against merge base 3a2f4c00, the head's check-runs (read 2026-10-30T18:32Z: 50 check-runs, all completed: 40 success, 10 skipped (path-filtered), 0 failed, 0 cancelled. Success: Auto Label, Build & E2E UI, Build Core, Build UI Deps, Check Changeset, Check PR Size, Dogfood Regression Gate, Flag docs affected by code changes, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Lint & Repo Gates, Lint · CI, release & engine gates, Lint · ESLint, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · scoped · query-options erasure, Lint · scoped · slot lookup & corpus, Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests, Live E2E UI, PR-body guards (claim · duplicate · Part-of · single-writer path), Plan Test Core shards, Spec property liveness, Test Core, Test Core (all 8), Test UI, Type Check UI, Type Check · consumer gates, Type Check · debt ledger, Type Check · source gates, Type Check · workspace, TypeScript Type Check, filter. Skipped: 18.x upgrade harness (opt-in), Build Docs, Dogfood Regression Gate (matrix shard of 3), Dogfood Verify CLI, Lint UI, Packed-tarball smoke (opt-in), Schedule gate · skip when a green push run covers the commit, Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL), Test UI (matrix shard of 16), UI Published Artifacts.). The card's Wanted asks for a `name` help that states both outcomes with the three hand translations following; triage scoped the optional Console prompt out as its own p3 card.

### ① Derived judgments

- The diff is copy-only on a form row: `permissionForm` Identity `name` helpText changes; `required`, `colSpan`, the row set and `PermissionSetSchema` do not. The existing case "moves no accept set: the schema still parses a set with no label" stays in the test file unchanged, so the no-accept-set claim is pinned, not asserted.
- The new wording is true to the cited code: `slugify` NFKD-normalises, lowercases and replaces every run outside `[a-z0-9]` (createDerive.ts:26-31), and an empty derivation clears the target "so the UI knows to prompt" (createDerive.ts:181-182). "Latin letters and digits" is the exact accept set of the fill; a mixed label still fills from its Latin part, which the help also says.
- Translations: en equals the source string (the generator's output per the PR body); zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES carry the two-case meaning (fill from Latin letters/digits; otherwise type it; snake_case). Hand-editing leaf values of the generated bundles is what the file header prescribes ("Edit translations in place … only the leaf string values"), so the edit is in the sanctioned form.
- Test: the help case now asserts "from the label", "type it", `snake_case` and a control that the unconditional "derived from the label" is gone; it fails on the old text (the PR's reverse verification) and holds the new wording to its two outcomes.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/spec` patch + `@objectstack/platform-objects` patch with `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`, matching the diff.

### ② Semver level

patch. Help text on a metadata form and four translation leaves; no schema, accept set, error code, generated key or form structure moves. `Clause-②: no` on the PR body and the changeset is the right declaration.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Stays in `packages/spec` + `packages/platform-objects`; no `ui/` change, consistent with triage scoping the Console prompt out. No governed path, no ADR, no docs page.
- Generated bundles touched by hand at leaf level only; the structure is untouched, so `check:generated` and the i18n bundle gate keep their contract (CI confirms).
- Should-fix (not blocking): the en/zh help is now long for a `colSpan: 1` control; if the form renderer truncates helpText, the second clause (the one this card exists for) is the part that gets cut. Check once on the Console create form; shortening to one sentence per case is a copy-only follow-up.

### ④ Design judgment

The change holds against the code it cites and the scenario it is accepted against. The card's defect is a promise ("derived from the label") that is false for exactly the product's first two locales; the fix states the real rule of the fill (`slugify`'s `[a-z0-9]` keep set) and the user's move when it yields nothing, which is also what createDerive.ts says the UI should prompt for. It does not pretend to fix the missing prompt, and it does not touch the derivation, so it cannot drift from `anchors.ts` when other types gain the same wiring. The PR's measured claim that no other `*.form.ts` `name` help promises a fill means this is the only row that misleads; the remaining types stay accurate without a change. Platform-first, ui-next ordering matches the triage ruling.
